name: Memori
ontology_notes: Attribution is entity_id (who), process_id (which agent), session_id (thread). Extracted types are Facts, Preferences, Skills, Rules, Events, plus Agent Trace. Memories class in memori/memory/_struct.py holds Conversation summary, Entity facts/triples, Process attributes. Knowledge graph is semantic triples per entity. No character vs relationship vs lore types.

ontology.evidence: docs/memori-byodb/concepts/how-memory-works.mdx tables Facts, Preferences, Skills, Rules, Events, Agent Trace. _struct.py Entity/Process/Conversation/SemanticTriple. multi-user-support.mdx: facts/preferences/skills/KG are per entity; attributes per process; conversations per entity+process+session.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Wrapped LLM client captures the turn. Advanced Augmentation (advanced-augmentation.mdx) async-extracts facts and triples. attribution() must be set before calls. No documented write refusal.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: how-memory-works.mdx Automatic Recall: on every LLM call, semantic search injects top facts into the system prompt. Manual mem.recall(query, limit). recall_relevance_threshold default 0.1 can drop all hits.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: how-memory-works.mdx lifecycle is capture, extract, store, recall. No update/invalidate/isLatest language. New facts accumulate on the entity. Triple extraction can duplicate rather than close old facts.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Each recalled fact has date_created. LoCoMo temporal category 90.3% in results.mdx. No validity-window query API in how-memory-works.mdx.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: entity_id vs process_id is user vs agent/workflow. Facts are shared across processes for the same entity (multi-user-support.mdx). That leaks a support-bot fact into a sales-bot. Not user vs character vs relationship.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Automatic recall injects whatever passes the similarity threshold. No social skip.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Attribution tags who/what/when. Extracted assistant text can become entity facts. No trust tags or jailbreak filter in how-memory-works.mdx.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: how-memory-works.mdx and README document capture, recall, and MCP, not a forget/delete API. Open until a primary page names erasure.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: results.mdx: mean 721 added tokens per LoCoMo query (2.8% of full context). Augmentation is async extra LLM. Automatic recall embeds the query and injects facts every turn (fastembed all-MiniLM-L6-v2 default).
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Apache-2.0 LICENSE. BYODB SQLite/Postgres/MySQL/MongoDB. README OpenAI default. Intimate chat can stay on one machine with a local DB and local LLM if registered.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official hosted MCP at https://api.memorilabs.ai/mcp/. README claude mcp add. memorilabs.ai/llms.txt MCP overview and client setup.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Entity vs process is multi-agent CRM isolation, not companion identity. Facts about the user are one bag shared across processes. Automatic system-prompt inject is the shared premise. No relationship type, no silence, supersession not specified, forget API not found in the pages read.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo
published_eval.claimed_score: Overall 87.0% LLM-as-judge (single-hop 88.5, multi-hop 83.7, open-domain 72.9, temporal 90.3). Mean 721 added tokens (2.8% of 26031 full-context).
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: LoCoMo fact/temporal/multi-hop QA on long assistant conversations, compared to Zep/LangMem/Mem0. Not character drift or social silence.

open_unknowns: Whether OSS/BYODB exposes delete-memory equivalent to Cloud dashboard.
How triples for a superseded fact are marked, if at all.
Hosted MCP vs local MCP for BYODB.
